regions.region: upper and left columns: title, introduction, author notes, and SI-availability statement
regions.finding: Background/cited chemistry and high-level present-paper claims were distinguished from row-level experiments; the online SI statement was not treated as an associated source.

regions.region: right-center Table 1, reaction drawing, five rows, and footnote a
regions.finding: Five independent optimization entries were extracted, including initial-water and bromine equivalents, duration, two product yields, the printed dash, and the direct-thiosulfate-quench exception.
Narrative values were linked to the corresponding table rows; no duplicate experiments were created.

unresolved: Table 1 does not report yield basis, atmosphere, absolute scale, detailed workup, or purification.
The entry-4 dash is undefined; the prose says 3a was the only product, so both source expressions are retained without converting the dash to zero.
The main text mentions online Supporting Information, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.region: upper-left Table 2 reaction drawing, 14 scope rows, and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: All fourteen substrate-scope rows were extracted independently; bromine/time overrides and the direct aqueous-thiosulfate quench were applied only to their marked rows.

regions.region: middle-left Table 3 reaction drawing, four enantioenriched rows, and ee footnote
regions.finding: Four independent asymmetric-scope experiments were extracted with starting and product ee, product yields, the shared duration range, and chiral-HPLC measurement basis.
Scheme 1 was split into isolation of intermediate 5l and its separate conversion to (E)-3l; Figure 2 is structural evidence for trans-5l, not another reaction.

regions.region: lower-left Figure 1 and lower-right mechanistic prose
regions.finding: Figure 1 was linked as structural context for (S)-(E)-3m; the proposed pathway was classified as a mechanism and linked to the page-3 drawing.

unresolved: Tables 2 and 3 generally omit yield basis, atmosphere, absolute scale, solvent volume, detailed workup, and purification.
Table 3 gives a common 10–25 min range without assigning an exact duration to each row.
Scheme 1 omits several quantities and operational details; intermediate and stereochemical structures remain unverified.

regions.finding: The multistep pathway through 5m, 6, 7, and 8 was classified as a proposed mechanism rather than a reported experiment.

regions.region: lower-left conclusion, dates, keywords, and references 1-3
regions.finding: No additional row-level present-paper experiment was found; cited works were not mined as associated sources.

regions.region: right column references and crystallographic notes 10-13
regions.finding: Crystal data and CCDC identifiers were treated as characterization/reference context, not as reaction experiments or supplied SI.

unresolved: Mechanistic intermediates and stereochemical details remain proposed and unverified.
CCDC deposits and online Supporting Information were mentioned but were not supplied or explicitly associated.
Reference 11 describes a cited oxidation route to chiral allenyl sulfones without a compound-specific procedure or yield on this page; it was not promoted to a present-paper experiment.
